Kill [[Justiciar Marron]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Justiciar Marron]] in [[Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)|Kessex Peak]]
* *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Marron in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 10 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
The [[Temple of the Ages]] is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through [[The Black Curtain (War in Kryta)|The Black Curtain]] to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and [[White Mantle]]/[[Peacekeeper]]s along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest, towards the southern edge of the map, and you will eventually run into Marron. Kill him and then claim your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"Justiciar Marron is an avid collector of magical artifacts and tomes. He has always been known to use his status among the White Mantle to "liberate" these prized possessions from the citizens of Kryta, but only recently has his greed cost innocent lives. Those unwilling to turn over their magical artifacts to Marron are tried for treason and executed immediately. The artifacts are, naturally, confiscated as "evidence" by Marron. This murderous thief was last seen in Kessex Peak, hoping to succeed where Galrath failed and gain access to the [[Wizard's Tower]] and the riches inside. Queen Salma offers a generous bounty to anyone who can put an end to Justiciar Marron!"''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Re-create this classic event from the War in Kryta! Justiciar Marron was an avid collector of magical artifacts and tomes. Known for using his status among the White Mantle to "liberate" these prized possessions from the citizens of Kryta, Marron tried and executed anyone who resisted his thievery. This murderous thief met his end in Kessex Peak during the war when brave adventurers claimed the bounty on Marron's head. Relive the hunt for Justiciar Marrion and earn a generous royal bounty!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = Justicar Marron makes for the Wizard's Tower in Kessex Peak. Strike down this murderous thief before his greed costs more Krytans their lives!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you [Character Name], your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

==Notes==
* It is efficient to do this quest with [[Wanted: Destor the Truth Seeker]] and [[Wanted: Justiciar Amilyn]] for a total of 45 supplies in Hard Mode. These bosses are close to each other and their bounties are relatively close in the quest cycle. You still need to accept each quest on the day it's available.
